intro: Notice which syllable is stressed and when Spanish writes an accent mark.
b1.texto: Every Spanish word with more than one syllable has a stressed syllable. As a useful first guide, words ending in a vowel, **n** or **s** usually stress the next-to-last syllable; words ending in other consonants usually stress the last. A written accent mark shows exceptions, as in **café**, **lápiz** and **canción**. Words stressed on the antepenultimate syllable always carry an accent: **música**, **teléfono**. Question and exclamation words carry an accent mark even in indirect questions: **¿Qué quieres? / No sé qué quieres.** Compare **qué** with **que** in **Creo que sí**.
b2.nota: Capital letters show the stressed syllable; the written accent is shown where needed.
b3.f0: What is your classmate’s name? I do not know which book she wants, but I think it is a novel.
b5.pregunta: Which word has a written accent because its stress does not follow the usual ending pattern?
b5.o0.refuerzo: Café has a tilde because it is stressed on the last syllable, not the usual one.
b5.o1.refuerzo: Casa follows the usual stress rule, so it needs no written accent.
b5.o2.refuerzo: Libros follows the regular stress pattern, so it needs no written accent.
b6.pregunta: Choose the correct spelling in: «No sé ____ quieres».
b6.o0.refuerzo: Qué with an accent marks a question word, as in an indirect question like I don't know what.
b6.o1.refuerzo: Que without accent is a relative or conjunction, not the question word in this sentence.
b6.o2.refuerzo: Qúe is not valid; the accent goes on the e, giving qué.
b7.o0.refuerzo: Canción ends in n with stress on the last syllable, so it needs the tilde.
b7.o1.refuerzo: Cancion lacks the tilde; words ending in n with final stress need one.
b7.o2.refuerzo: Cánsion has the accent in the wrong place; canción is stressed on the last syllable.
b8.o0: I do not know what her name is.
b8.o1: I know how to call her.
b8.o1.explicacion: Check the meaning of the Spanish sentence.
b8.o2: I do not know where she lives.
b8.o2.explicacion: Check the meaning of the Spanish sentence.
b9.traduccion: What song are you listening to?
b8.o0.explicacion: No sé cómo se llama means I don't know what her name is.
